status: complete preparation design; proposed experiment protocol; no fitted-model results
working_title: SynRXN Context: Benchmarking Reaction Assay Prediction and Observed Condition Ranking

population.exclusion: 192 rows with missing canonical reactants; retain a complete exclusion ledger
population.target_interpretation: Recorded UV area assay response on the source percentage scale; not independently calibrated isolated yield
population.target_units: percentage points for errors and observed regret
population.target_zero: Keep as recorded; do not relabel as infeasible
population.repeated_cell_rows: Multiple rows sharing recorded settings are not assumed to be independent technical replicates

questions.question: How much do the three permitted context representations change assay prediction and ranking of recorded conditions on held-out dependence components?
questions.comparison: Same records, folds, endpoint access, feature-adapter rules, tuning budget, prediction denominator and model families; only the context policy changes
questions.explanatory_contrast: retained_context versus flat_context; source_context versus retained_context
questions.outcome_direction: Open; report improvements, no meaningful difference, and degradation

questions.question: How does a row allocation change assay-error estimates and model comparisons relative to the declared relation closure?
questions.comparison: Full source context; out-of-fold predictions for the same eligible rows; disclose changed training exposure
questions.scope: Regression diagnostic only; no ranking from candidates scored by different row-fold models
questions.causal_limit: This changes the evaluation setting and information exposure; a score gap alone does not identify a universal causal leakage penalty

input_contract.endpoints: Recorded unmapped reactants and products supplied to every predictive model; retrospective reaction-conditioned assay evaluation
input_contract.prospective_limit: Recorded product availability does not establish a prospective planned-product or forward-prediction task
input_contract.flat_context: Six explicit fields in synrxn/data/task_protocols.json yield.context_fields
input_contract.retained_context: The existing yield table conditions_json, with numeric formatting normalized and missing entries kept unknown
input_contract.source_context: The 21 pinned original preparation fields listed by prepare_cohort.RAW_CONTEXT; no other original columns
withheld: sample, reaction, compound, screen and notebook identifiers
source labels, provenance strings and split assignments
input_contract.role_interpretation: Keep original Catalyst_1/Catalyst_2 and reagent slot meanings; do not infer catalyst/base/ligand roles from missing fields
input_contract.numeric_missingness: Train-only median imputation plus explicit missing indicators; a recorded zero remains a value
input_contract.categorical_missingness: Missing and unseen-in-training get different indicators; vocabulary fit on training inputs only
input_contract.name_canonicalization: Keep exact source strings in primary analysis; any spelling/alias correction requires a versioned mapping audit
input_contract.unsupported_chemistry: Record structure parsing and feature failures; use the frozen training-median fallback, not silent row removal

memberships.closure_population: All canonical source rows before eligibility exclusion; absent relation values never link cases
memberships.allocation: Sort components by descending eligible-row count and seeded identity hash; assign each to the least loaded fold without targets
memberships.row_diagnostic: Same size-balanced algorithm on opaque sample IDs; overlaps explicitly audited
memberships.pretraining: Primary models fitted from scratch; any later pretrained model is a separate exposure-qualified analysis
memberships.test_policy: Do not use outer-fold results to select features, hyperparameters or manuscript claims; archive deviations and every attempted configuration

training.row_weight: 1 / number of rows in the same recorded input cell, renormalized over training rows only
training.weight_support: Apply exactly for Ridge, random forest and MPNN losses; nearest-neighbor predictions average repeated training cells before retrieval; baseline median uses the same cell weights
training.validation_selection: Component-macro MAE for grouped folds; row MAE for the row-allocation diagnostic; identical rule for all methods in each setting
training.seed_aggregation: Average metrics across independently fitted seeds; no undeclared prediction ensemble
training.early_stopping: Validation only; at most 100 epochs, patience 15 for the MPNN
training.test_failure_fallback: Training weighted median fixed before test access; emit failure category and fallback flag
training.prediction_clipping: None in primary scores; preserve finite values outside 0-100

models.version_target: 2.3.1; verify and pin the installed build during pilot
models.formulation: Separate pooled reactant/product molecular graphs plus the same permitted context features; no requirement for new atom mapping

feature_adapter.classical_endpoints: Two Morgan radius-2, 2048-bit blocks with chirality enabled for unmapped reactants and products, with fixed molecule-parse policy
feature_adapter.context_molecules: Parse whitelisted source SMILES slots into separate radius-2 2048-bit blocks with chirality enabled; remove atom-map identifiers from feature identities; keep the corresponding source text and parse/missing masks in all predictive models
feature_adapter.context_text: Train-only categorical vocabulary for each exact source slot; no external name-to-structure service
feature_adapter.context_numbers: Train-only imputation and scaling plus missing/invalid indicators
feature_adapter.information_parity: Every predictive family receives all fields allowed by its context contract; serialize adapter versions and input hashes

evaluation.regression_primary: Mean of component-specific row MAE across the 285 components, using each row's out-of-fold prediction
regression_secondary: valid-model prediction coverage and fallback fraction
evaluation.ranking_panel: screen_id + chemical_split_group + measurement type + exact recorded UV wavelength; unknown wavelength is a distinct stratum
evaluation.ranking_candidate: One unique normalized 21-field source context within a panel
evaluation.candidate_response: Median recorded assay response among rows sharing that input cell; descriptive summary, not an inferred independent replicate mean
evaluation.candidate_prediction: Mean prediction across the same cell rows, all scored by the same held-out-component model
evaluation.ranking_primary: Panel-macro observed regret@1 = best recorded candidate-response median minus response median of the selected candidate
ranking_secondary: probability of selecting a candidate within 5 percentage points of the observed best
evaluation.tie_policy: Average uniformly over score ties; exact mean response for top-1 ties, and exact combinatorial expectation at a top-k boundary; never break ties using outcomes
evaluation.ranking_limit: Only the observed candidate set is evaluated; unmeasured conditions are unknown, not negatives; no counterfactual, causal or wet-lab optimization claim
evaluation.uncertainty: 2000 paired bootstrap draws of dependence components; recompute the relevant macro statistic and retain all panels within sampled components; report seed ranges separately
evaluation.comparisons: Primary family: source-versus-flat effects for four predictive families and two metrics, eight contrasts total; use component-bootstrap maximum standardized deviation for simultaneous 95% intervals. Other pointwise intervals are descriptive. Claimed pairwise model ordering also requires a separately declared simultaneous family; otherwise label ordering exploratory
evaluation.delta_interpretation: Reporting reference values chosen for planning; not established chemical measurement tolerances or acceptance gates
evaluation.ranking_claim: Claim a model-order change only when the relevant paired comparison supports it; otherwise report uncertainty

secondary_scope.bh_replication: Supporting analysis only: remove all HiTEA-labeled BH rows and all shared declared transformation/reactant keys; retain original measurement qualifications; compare Ridge and random forest without inventing screening IDs
secondary_scope.bh_split: For each named target source, train on the other six available non-HiTEA sources; use grouped validation in training sources and remove target-overlapping declared keys before fitting
secondary_scope.bh_search: 8 configurations per model per named target; no neural extension until the core study is reproduced
secondary_scope.frea: Evidence-semantics audit only; prior FREA already supplies expert labels and source-dependent evaluation
secondary_scope.mechanisms: Qualified structural-reference companion; predictive benchmark deferred beyond this submission's critical path
secondary_scope.orderly: Related work and possible later condition-reconstruction study; no new generic role-aware condition leaderboard in the core paper

compute_allocation.interpretation: Capacity reservations, not measured runtime estimates; pilot measures peak RAM, wall time and extrapolated cost before the main grid
reduction_order: keep all 5 outer folds but reduce repeated stochastic fits from 3 to 1 and disclose
reduce the common per-family tuning budget before any outer test result is inspected
compute_allocation.core_requirement: Retain the source/retained/flat context contrast, all five model families including a learned baseline, and all eligible records

scope_role: Detailed optional HiTEA case study; superseded as the overall SynRXN scope
